sources.title: Report on the Proceedings of the Pamir Boundary Commission
sources.institution: Government of India, Foreign Department / Office of the Superintendent of Government Printing, Calcutta
sources.coverage: Official commission report on the 1895 Pamir delimitation and demarcation, protocols, pillars, survey work and boundary descriptions
sources.notes: The official Government of India report records the sequence of pillar erection and protocol signatures, including agreement on final pillars 9-12 on 8 September 1895 and signature of the final protocol on 10 September 1895. It also distinguishes watershed, spur and river-course portions of the line.

sources.title: Map of the country on both sides of the boundary line drawn by the Joint Commission for delimiting the Russian and Afghan territories on the Pamirs 1895
sources.institution: British Library, India Office Records and Private Papers / Qatar Digital Library
sources.coverage: Contemporary signed Joint Commission boundary map, reduced from the commissioners' signed original and officially certified as a true representation
sources.notes: British Library Mss Eur F111/68, f 28. The map depicts the demarcated boundary, relief and hydrology; it bears the British and Russian commissioners' signatures. Major-General John Charles Ardagh certified that the reproduction truly represents the signed original.

sources.title: International Boundary Study No. 26 (Revised) — Afghanistan–U.S.S.R. Boundary
sources.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Geographer, Bureau of Intelligence and Research
sources.coverage: Official U.S. boundary study consolidating treaty continuity, the 1895 Pamir protocols and four coordinate realizations for the eastern Wakhan pillars, including WGS 72
sources.notes: The study states that the 1958 Soviet-Afghan frontier treaty retained the 1895 Demarcation Protocols for the Zor-Kul-to-China sector. It publishes Pamir Boundary Commission 1895, Indian 1916, WGS 72 and Pulkovo 1942 coordinate values for the control pillars and explains the 1912-13/1921 recalculation history.

sources.title: A Collection of Treaties, Engagements and Sanads relating to India and neighbouring countries — Afghanistan section
sources.institution: British Library, India Office Records and Private Papers / Qatar Digital Library
sources.coverage: Official documentary compilation recording the 1895 Pamir settlement as ten protocols and delivery to the Amir of the signed map and demarcated-line description
sources.notes: The compilation records that the Joint Commission settlement was contained in ten protocols and that the Amir received copies of the map signed by Gerard and Povalo-Scheikovski together with a description of the demarcated line.
